title: Soil Moisture Crash After Repotting
dataSources: Planta plant care events (`planta:plant`), Govee soil readings (`govee:soil`), Philips Hue grow-light cycles (`hue:event`), and SensorPush dome climate (`sensorpush:climate`).
app: Planta reminders, Govee soil sensors, Philips Hue grow-light schedules, and SensorPush humidity-dome readings streamed into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=govee:soil repotted_recently=yes moisture_pct=*
| timechart span=1d min(moisture_pct) as min_moisture by pot_name
| fillnull value=0
description: Tracks recently repotted plants for unusually sharp moisture drops over the following days.
value: Repotting stress is easiest to catch in the first week, when roots and substrate behave differently from the old setup.
implementation: Tag a `repotted_recently=yes` window on the soil-sensor stream and review the daily minimum moisture after repotting.
visualization: Daily line chart of minimum moisture by recently repotted pot.
grandmaExplanation: It watches whether a newly repotted plant is drying out much faster than expected.
